$comment: The work.* event kinds the activity integrations suggest (docs/protocol.md §16) and the ones people's own tools send (docs/work-and-briefings.md). Declared with deploy/scripts/declare-work-kinds.mjs; every kind has the same fields, the activity item's flat part plus the coding-session ones (repo, branch, areas, commits, turns, endedAt). POST /api/brain/work declares work.session itself on first use. The GitHub kinds (work.pr_closed … work.ci_passed) list their own fields, the Git host's, because a kind declares at most 20.

fields.name: source
fields.description: The tool the activity happened in: slack, google-drive, notion, linear…

fields.name: sourceId
fields.description: Stable id of this version of the item in its tool (replaying it is the same event)

fields.name: url
fields.description: Link to the item

fields.name: actor
fields.description: Email of the person who did it

fields.name: title
fields.description: One line: the message, page, issue, deal or meeting

fields.name: summary
fields.description: What happened, clipped to 200 characters

fields.name: team
fields.description: Team hint (a shared drive, a Linear team, a channel mapping)

fields.name: initiative
fields.description: Initiative or project hint

fields.name: customer
fields.description: Customer hint (a customer channel, folder, company or attendee domain)

fields.name: occurredAt
fields.description: When it happened (ISO 8601)

fields.name: repo
fields.description: The repository, owner/name

fields.name: branch
fields.description: The branch

fields.name: areas
fields.description: Directory names touched, comma-joined

fields.name: commits
fields.description: Commits made

fields.name: turns
fields.description: Turns of the conversation with the assistant

fields.name: prs
fields.description: Pull requests opened or merged

fields.name: prUrl
fields.description: The first pull request

fields.name: endedAt
fields.description: When it ended (ISO 8601)

kinds.description: A message or comment in a discussion (Slack, Linear or Attio comments)
A decision someone recorded
A bug was reported
Something shipped: a release, a completed project or cycle
A deal was won
A deal or pipeline entry changed stage
A meeting was scheduled or changed (it hasn't ended)
A meeting took place
A meeting was cancelled (only when a trigger's Include Cancelled Events is on)
Notes or a summary of a meeting
An action item or task someone owns
A document or page was created or edited
A ticket or issue changed state
A feature was requested
A pull request was opened (from a Git host integration, or from claude-code, landflow-cli and mcp)
A pull request was merged (from a Git host integration, or from claude-code, landflow-cli and mcp)
A pull request was closed without being merged
